## TL;DR

Merged current `main` (which already carried the drawer/`completeTask` guards and `done-click-reason.test.ts`), kept branch-only server/tests (`landAnywayReasonError`, `task-drawer-landable` POST-body tests, `done-guard`), and stabilized `agent-review` land-anyway ordering for remote-validator timing.

## Work and rationale

Review pass 1 failed landability on merge conflicts in `TaskDrawer.vue`/`repo.ts`, dirty `agent-review.test.ts`, and `needs some work` verdict. Resolved conflicts by adopting main’s `reason?: unknown` guards (equivalent to branch logic), merged `main`, committed the test reorder, and restored this task’s `work/1119` frontmatter from the branch tip (main’s copy was a held duplicate).

## Approaches tried

Conflict resolution favored main’s inline comments and `undefined` reason handling over duplicate branch wording. Land-anyway API test runs before follow-up POST so auto-bounce cannot flip status to `active` first on loaded CI hosts.

## Challenges and blockers

Main hotfixed the same bug while #1119 was in flight; merge was required rather than duplicate client logic. Remote full-suite load exposed a pre-existing `agent-review` race unrelated to the drawer click bug.

## Key learnings

When a hotfix lands on `main` during an open branch, merge early and keep only deltas (server message test, drawer component test, audit notes). Validator timing tests should assert land-anyway before async auto-bounce.
